mostWorthwhile.text: Building the joint was worthwhile because the pictures connected cartilage and fluid with movement, then showed ligaments supporting it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to add bone cells directly was confusing because their picture already showed them inside bone.

surprise.text: Inspecting the bone cells showed that they needed a blood supply first; the picture explained how nutrients reach them through channels.

arbitrary.text: The requirement to combine the cells with blood vessels before adding them to the bone was not clear beforehand, although the result helped explain it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: putting the joint together made its parts' different jobs easier to picture, and I would be curious to see how movement develops further.
